edition.notes: Friedlander's English translation is in the public domain and is the version most widely retranscribed online. It is made from the Judaeo-Arabic with reference to the Hebrew and its scriptural references occasionally misnumber a verse; the reference at Part II chapter 46 to Genesis 15 verse 6 is to verse 5. Keep it distinct from Pines' 1963 translation, which is under copyright and was not consulted. Catalog-level record created 2026-07-26. No exact artifact has been registered; publications consulting a digital delivery of this edition record their own access route and limits locally.

edition.title: The Guide for the Perplexed, translated by M. Friedlander, second edition

work.author: Moses ben Maimon (Maimonides)
work.description: Maimonides' Guide of the Perplexed, written in Judaeo-Arabic in the late twelfth century and translated into Hebrew in his lifetime. Part II chapters 32 to 48 treat prophecy; chapter 46 argues that when Scripture introduces an account as a vision, everything narrated within it belongs to the vision, including movement from place to place. A locus is part.chapter.
work.title: Moreh Nevukhim
